flow.overviewSubtitle: Review the default flow, configured rules, and items worth checking
flow.overviewNote: This overview uses the values currently shown in the cards below. Save the flow rules for your changes to take effect.
flow.reviewInactive: Rule {number} is inactive and will not apply to submitted documents
flow.reviewIncomplete: Rule {number} has no department or role selected
flow.reviewDuplicate: More than one rule matches {target} · {kind}; verify that the overlapping conditions are intentional
flow.priorityNote: Rule priority: department + specific document type → department + all types → role + specific document type → role + all types. If multiple rules share the same conditions and priority, the first matching rule is used.
flow.accessByGroup: Effective flow by department and role
flow.accessByGroupNote: Expand a department and role to see the route for each document type. The system selects a rule using the priority shown below; if none matches, it uses the system default flow.
flow.defaultEmployeeRoute: Department manager (if any) → HR; otherwise sent directly to HR
flow.defaultHrRoute: Managing director → another HR approver (not the submitter)

noteItems: Sick leave must be submitted immediately upon returning to work. A medical certificate is required for leave on the first or last workday of a week, leave spanning a holiday, or sick leave of three or more workdays.
Personal and unpaid leave must be requested at least one day in advance and approved by a manager.
Vacation must be requested at least 15 days in advance and approved by a manager.
Employees must submit leave requests according to policy and receive manager approval before HR records the leave.
